subject: Invitation to Complete Your Interview – Ace Healthcare Recruitment Limited
latest_message:
Dear Applicant,

Thank you for submitting your application to Ace Healthcare Recruitment Limited. We acknowledge receipt of your details and are pleased to invite you to the next stage of our selection process.

As part of our streamlined recruitment procedure, all candidates are required to complete a preliminary AI-led interview via our partners Interview System. This assessment enables us to evaluate your suitability for the role in a fair, efficient, and consistent manner.

Interview Instructions
